```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run in dry-run mode (no publishing, no pushing)'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      version-scheme:
        description: 'Version scheme to use'
        required: true
        default: 'semver'
        type: choice
        options:
          - semver
          - date-based

env:
  MAVEN_OPTS: --add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens=java.base/java.lang.reflect=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens=java.base/java.text=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens=java.desktop/java.awt.font=ALL-UNNAMED

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: release-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || github.token }}

      - name: Validate required secrets
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" ]]; then
            echo "Missing required secrets"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Import GPG key
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg@v6
        with:
          gpg_private_key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          passphrase: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}

      - name: Set up Maven settings
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.m2
          cat > ~/.m2/settings.xml << EOF
          <settings>
            <servers>
              <server>
                <id>ossrh</id>
                <username>${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}</username>
                <password>${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}</password>
              </server>
            </servers>
            <profiles>
              <profile>
                <id>release</id>
                <properties>
                  <gpg.executable>gpg</gpg.executable>
                  <gpg.passphrase>${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}</gpg.passphrase>
                </properties>
              </profile>
            </profiles>
          </settings>
          EOF

      - name: Determine next version
        id: version
        run: |
          # Simple version bump logic for pre-1.0.0-GA
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.version-scheme }}" == "date-based" ]]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(date +%Y.%m.%d)
          else
            IFS='.' read -ra VERSION_PARTS <<< "$CURRENT_VERSION"
            MAJOR="${VERSION_PARTS[0]}"
            MINOR="${VERSION_PARTS[1]}"
            PATCH="${VERSION_PARTS[2]}"
            
            if [[ "$PATCH" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
              NEW_PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              NEW_VERSION="$MAJOR.$MINOR.$NEW_PATCH"
            else
              NEW_VERSION="$MAJOR.$MINOR.1"
            fi
          fi
          
          echo "new_version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update version in pom.xml
        run: |
          mvn versions:set -DnewVersion="${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}" -DgenerateBackupPoms=false

      - name: Build and test
        run: |
          mvn clean verify -Prelease

      - name: Dry run mode check
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.dry-run == 'true' }}
        run: |
          echo "Running in dry-run mode - skipping publish and push"
          exit 0

      - name: Publish to Maven Central
        run: |
          mvn deploy -Prelease -DskipTests

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        run: |
          docker login -u ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }} -p ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
          mvn compile jib:build -Djib.to.image=rrobetti/ojp:${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} -DskipTests

      - name: Update documentation
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}"
          find . -name "*.md" -type f -exec sed -i "s/ojp:[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/ojp:$NEW_VERSION/g" {} \;
          find . -name "*.md" -type f -exec sed -i "s/rrobetti\/ojp:[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/rrobetti\/ojp:$NEW_VERSION/g" {} \;
          find . -name "*.md" -type f -exec sed -i "s/\[ojp\]: https:\/\/repo1\.maven\.org\/maven2\/com\/openjproxy\/ojp\/[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/\[ojp\]: https:\/\/repo1\.maven\.org\/maven2\/com\/openjproxy\/ojp\/$NEW_VERSION/g" {} \;

      - name: Commit and push version updates
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
